speaker: Doctor
text:
Please describe the exact nature of the bleeding since your wisdom tooth extraction and any other instances of easy bruising you've experienced. 

Also, have you ever had a nosebleed that wouldn't stop, or experienced excessive bleeding after minor cuts?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history; the family pattern of bleeding and joint swelling in your uncle is particularly concerning for a hereditary disorder. To narrow this down, have you ever been told you have hemophilia, and does your mother's family have any history of bleeding issues? Also, do you take any aspirin or NSAIDs regularly?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).

REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Panel (PT, PTT), Factor VIII Activity, Factor IX Activity.
REQUEST IMAGES: No acute imaging required, but please review any prior joint X-rays if available to assess for hemophilic arthropathy.
